skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental theories about the state, including its origin, nature, functions, types, and forms, as well as the relationship between the state and individuals in a legal state.
Understand fundamental theories about the socialist republic state of Vietnam.
Apply skills in group work, communication, presentation, and public speaking.
Develop the ability to independently research, accumulate, and enhance knowledge.
Analyze and discuss theories and concepts related to the state and law.
Effectively present and defend research findings.
